place.name: Fortaleza
place.description: Fortaleza ( FOR-tə-LAY-zə ; Brazilian Portuguese: [foʁtaˈlezɐ] ; Portuguese for 'Fortress') is the state capital and largest city of the state of Ceará, located in Northeastern Brazil. It is Brazil's fourth-most-populous city after Sao Paulo, Rio De Janeiro, and Brasilia, with a population of 2,578,483 as of 2025, and 12th-largest among cities with the highest gross domestic product.
